eq-ch11-reflecting-parity: Reflecting wall ghosts: even components mirrored, normal velocity mirrored with a sign change.
eq-ch11-periodic-copy: Periodic ghosts copy the matching owned cells from the other end, an exact permutation.
eq-ch11-extrapolation-copy: Extrapolation ghosts repeat the nearest owned cell.
eq-ch11-outflow-modes: Outflow characteristic variables: the two acoustic combinations and the entropy perturbation.
eq-ch11-outflow-inverse: Inverse of the characteristic split after the incoming modes are set to zero.
eq-ch11-outflow-admissible: The outflow ghost state is the background plus one scaled perturbation that keeps it admissible.
eq-ch11-exchange-corner: A corner ghost is the average of the two adjacent edge strips.
eq-ch11-solids-dp: Dynamic-programming update of the minimum flip cost for rectifying a solid mask with minimum run lengths.
eq-ch11-solids-closure: Reflecting closure of a fluid face against a solid in the implicit system, folded into the diagonal block.
eq-ch11-wb-continuation: Wall continuation of the hydrostatic $\rho/p$ ratio, linear in $\chi$ or in $\log\chi$ by the slope sign.
eq-ch11-wb-parity: Wall ghosts mirror the pressure and density perturbations about the hydrostatic reference.
